jobs.title: Principal Propulsion Engineer- Components
jobs.description_text: About This Role Varda is hiring an experienced Principal Propulsion Engineer- Components to join the team that designs, builds, tests, and flies the fluid components on the W-Series satellite bus and future vehicles. The W-Series satellite incorporates a high-test hydrogen peroxide (HTP) and hydrocarbon bipropellant propulsion system with high-pressure inert gas pressurization and cold-gas attitude control. The component portfolio spans each of these fluid subsystems and includes solenoid control valves, check valves, relief valves, burst disks, fluid filters, regulators, manually operated service valves, machined fluid manifolds, and instrumentation including pressure transducers and RTDs. A successful candidate will take on a significant share of the component ownership for these mission-critical hardware articles as responsible engineer, helping expand component capabilities, improve reliability, and increase flight cadence. Many current Varda components are purchased parts, and you will be a primary technical interface to our suppliers. Varda also intends to bring more component design in-house for current and future vehicles, and you will help lead that transition: shaping make-versus-buy decisions, executing detailed design, and standing up the capabilities to develop, qualify, produce, acceptance test, and fly Varda-owned parts. jobs.description_text: About This Role As a Principal RF Components Engineer at Varda, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring seamless connectivity between our satellite vehicles and ground stations. You will be responsible for the complete lifecycle of each RF component, collaborating closely with RF Systems Engineers to define component specifications and to either select or design the necessary hardware. Your work will be crucial in rigorously validating components before their deployment to space. This role requires a strong sense of ownership over your hardware, continually setting new standards for testing RF components before flight. Some people say that you only have one chance to fly to space so you must be certain it will work. At Varda, we believe that the trip to space and back is the easiest trip our hardware takes. We stress our components above and beyond the levels it should expect to see in flight and we investigate our failures thoroughly. Come join our team and build quality electronics that you will get to see fly over and over again. Responsibilities Serve as the Responsible Engineer for RF flight components, including radios, power amplifiers, antennas and filters. Collaborate with RF Systems Engineers to refine product specifications, select or design appropriate components, and oversee the entire product lifecycle. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Access Management
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software. Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person. We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Access Management
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software. Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting. We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person. We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration.
